nodes.label: ReloginClient Memory Probe and Glue Lua Executor
nodes.norm_label: reloginclient memory probe and glue lua executor
nodes.rationale: Reads GlueScreenString (0x00B6A9E0), g_ClientConnectionState (0x00BD0792), and IsLoadingOrConnecting (0x00B6AA38) via a short-lived read-only Win32 handle while unattached, invalidates DBC/cache pointers with StyxWoW.Reset(), and drives login glue via UTF-8 byte-escaped Lua.

nodes.label: .NET 10 x86 Stack and Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Uses net10.0-windows7.0 x86 with MahApps.Metro, Roslyn scripting, WCF, SQLite/FASM in Lib/, and native Navigation.dll; notes README mentions C# 10 while .csproj does not pin LangVersion.

nodes.label: CopilotBuddy
nodes.rationale: Targets WoW 3.3.5a build 12340 exclusively using an x86 .NET 10 WPF process to match the 32-bit game client; Cataclysm and later API features are intentional neutral stubs.

nodes.label: HBRelog
nodes.rationale: Deliberately kept strictly as a process launcher and WCF relay without combat, profile, or botbase logic so process supervision stays decoupled from bot execution.

nodes.label: Honorbuddy Provenance
nodes.rationale: Combines HB 4.3.4 API surface/architecture, HB 3.3.5a offsets/memory layout/Lua calls, and HB 6.2.3 Tripper.RecastManager navigation wrapper while leaving third-party routines and plugins under their original licenses.

nodes.label: Prebuilt Runtime Drop (output.zip)
nodes.rationale: output/ is gitignored while output.zip is tracked with prebuilt binaries, data databases, and 4x4 mmaps so players can launch without compiling or running an extractor.

nodes.label: Follow Honorbuddy Parity Rule
nodes.rationale: Fixes must reproduce original Honorbuddy behavior (3.3.5a first, then 4.3.4 or 5.x/6.x) and cite the HB version and method so the port does not diverge from HB semantics.

nodes.label: EndScene Hook and ASM/FASM Lua Layer
nodes.norm_label: endscene hook and asm/fasm lua layer
nodes.rationale: Executes Lua safely on the WoW main game thread via a custom EndScene hook and ASM/FASM injection alongside direct memory reads and writes.

nodes.label: Generation-Scoped ProcessMutex Recovery Claim
nodes.rationale: Claims relaunched PIDs per recovery generation so a second CopilotBuddy cannot attach to the new client while retired runs cannot release active or newer mutex claims.

nodes.label: ReloginSettings and Windows Credential Manager Vault
nodes.norm_label: reloginsettings and windows credential manager vault
nodes.rationale: Stores only PasswordReference in global Settings/ReloginSettings.xml while keeping credentials in the user-scoped Windows Credential Manager vault (migrating legacy plaintext entries on load) so exported settings never leak passwords.

nodes.label: PartyGrindSecrets.json, SquadSettings XML, and Start-PartyGrind.bat
nodes.rationale: Stores 32-byte per-character IPC secrets in Secrets/PartyGrindSecrets.json referenced from per-instance SquadSettings XML so secrets are never written into the generated launcher batch script.

nodes.label: PartyGrind Squad, Formation and Provisioning Settings
nodes.norm_label: partygrind squad, formation and provisioning settings

nodes.label: PartyGrind QuickStart Guide (3-5 Clients)
nodes.rationale: Binds each bot instance deterministically via -pid rather than window title, isolates per-instance config via -instance=ClientN, and requires an HBProfile with GrindArea/Hotspots.

nodes.label: PartyGrind xUnit Test Suite
nodes.rationale: Tests PartyGrind coordination and IPC logic with xUnit [Fact] cases and Dispose cleanup, while recognizing unit tests cannot replace live 3.3.5a verification.

nodes.label: In-Game 3.3.5a Verification and Log Rule
nodes.rationale: Requires live 3.3.5a server testing with before/after logs from the Logs folder because static builds alone cannot validate game-client behavior.

nodes.label: Isolation-Aware Tank Pull Spell Priority
nodes.rationale: Avoids 3-target Avenger's Shield bounces on packed mobs by using single-target openers, ordering Exorcism ahead of Avenger's Shield only on undead/demons because SpellManager.CanCast checks IsUsableSpell and Exorcism fails silently on humanoids.

nodes.label: Trash-Gated Breadcrumb Dungeon Advance
nodes.rationale: Clamps advance steps to 18 yd, shrinks boss fallback to 40 yd, blocks movement if attackable trash sits within 12 yd 2D (+-8 yd height tolerance so upper floors do not block) with an 8s escape, and preserves active forced steps across waiting/blocked branches.

nodes.label: Mana-Guarded Heal Bridge and Routine Handoff
nodes.norm_label: mana-guarded heal bridge and routine handoff
nodes.rationale: Lowers combat/OOC thresholds (75%/40%, <35% drink interrupt) below rest health trigger, enforces mana reserves in both HasHealCandidate and RunHealerTick, restricts RoutineManager HealBehavior handoff to combat <70% HP with StopActiveHealBehavior cleanup, and prioritizes heals over shields at low HP.

nodes.label: Deterministic Reachable Paladin Blessing Ownership
nodes.rationale: Assigns one blessing per target to the first reachable Paladin within 30 yd that knows it, includes self in roster calculations, and locks existing blessing slots to eliminate BoK/BoM overwrite loops and stale-roster aura collisions.

nodes.label: Synchronous Tick/Pulse Behavior Tree Contract
nodes.rationale: Botbases expose a TreeSharp.Composite Root driven by synchronous tick/pulse execution; async control flow must not be introduced into the bot loop without honoring this contract.

nodes.label: BotBase Synchronous Behavior Tree Architecture
nodes.rationale: Standardizes every botbase under Bots/ on Styx.BotBase running as a synchronous behavior tree.

nodes.label: In-World Confirmation and MainWindow Resume Lifecycle
nodes.norm_label: in-world confirmation and mainwindow resume lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Verifies in-world object walk and identity before reloading character settings/profile, re-pointing hotkeys, waiting 5s for old TreeRoot shutdown, and calling StartBot() rather than racing a live worker or duplicating start logic.

nodes.label: Runtime Singular wotlk SquadRole Namespace Breakage
nodes.norm_label: runtime singular wotlk squadrole namespace breakage
nodes.rationale: BotRoutines/** is excluded from CopilotBuddy.csproj and compiled only at runtime, so a wrong Styx.PartyGrind.IPC.SquadRole reference in Paladin/Common.cs bypassed dotnet build and silently forced fallback to DefaultCombatRoutine.

nodes.label: Memory Layout, Database and Runtime API Guardrails
nodes.norm_label: memory layout, database and runtime api guardrails
nodes.rationale: Avoid unprompted edits to memory offsets, memory structures, datadb binaries, Lib/ DLLs, or output.zip because offset changes can break the game client and main compilation misses runtime content errors.

nodes.label: No New Code Comments Policy
nodes.rationale: Only original Honorbuddy comments are kept in the codebase.

nodes.label: Runtime-Compiled Caller Compatibility Rule
nodes.rationale: Bots, plugins, routines, quest behaviors, and dungeon scripts in bin are compiled at runtime, so public method changes must be checked across all runtime callers.

nodes.label: Auto-Relogin Feature
nodes.rationale: Opt-in crash, hang, and disconnect recovery off by default; when disabled, creates no monitor thread, timer, polling, or memory probe.

nodes.label: Crash, Hang, and Two-State Logout Detection
nodes.norm_label: crash, hang, and two-state logout detection
nodes.rationale: Pairs worldDeparted (preserved across loading/unreadable polls while TreeRoot.IsRunning) with pendingLogout (reset on loading/unreadable polls, requiring 5s continuous login/charselect) so normal zoning or lag never false-triggers while logout through a loading screen still fires.

nodes.label: Wrong-Password vs Unreachable-Server Classifier
nodes.rationale: Because WoW 3.3.5a exposes no glue-error offset, classifies a login bounce as fatal credential rejection only when IsLoadingOrConnecting was never set after an actual DefaultServerLogin submission and return happened within LoginRejectSeconds with readable polls.
